So I judged they had our gang in a pretty tight place right at the outstart. But the king he only looked sorrowful, and says:", "sha256": "8cf7b828298cac4be604485cb0b753eac84cb834163bf59b30cf4ee17da25a47", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[27]", "source_html": "Everybody agreed to that. So I judged they had our gang in a pretty tight place right at the outstart. But the king he only looked sorrowful, and says:"}, {"id": "043-032-0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“Gentlemen, I wish the money was there, for I ain’t got no disposition to throw anything in the way of a fair, open, out-and-out investigation o’ this misable business; but, alas, the money ain’t there; you k’n send and see, if you want to.”", "sha256": "a25a063dd9c36a36922f455b91ad730cd726b9c176b68b23fe7c82a9375fb868", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[28]", "source_html": "“Gentlemen, I wish the money was there, for I ain’t got no disposition to throw anything in the way of a fair, open, out-and-out investigation o’ this misable business; but, alas, the money ain’t there; you k’n send and see, if you want to.”"}, {"id": "043-032-0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Where is it, then?”", "sha256": "975d2d4c04d223ef27b998bc28e9bb9bc58ea8da340e4efcc848fedff11103d2", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[29]", "source_html": "“Where is it, then?”"}, {"id": "043-032-0030", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, when my niece give it to me to keep for her I took and hid it inside o’ the straw tick o’ my bed, not wishin’ to bank it for the few days we’d be here, and considerin’ the bed a safe place, we not bein’ used to niggers, and suppos’n’ ’em honest, like servants in England. The niggers stole it the very next mornin’ after I had went down stairs; and when I sold ’em I hadn’t missed the money yit, so they got clean away with it. My servant here k’n tell you ’bout it, gentlemen.”", "sha256": "910bb362c53cf113ddc3ab99b105e8173789d1f315ec4d5c7b14ea5ddf65d8a1", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[30]", "source_html": "“Well, when my niece give it to me to keep for her I took and hid it inside o’ the straw tick o’ my bed, not wishin’ to bank it for the few days we’d be here, and considerin’ the bed a safe place, we not bein’ used to niggers, and suppos’n’ ’em honest, like servants in England. The niggers stole it the very next mornin’ after I had went down stairs; and when I sold ’em I hadn’t missed the money yit, so they got clean away with it. My servant here k’n tell you ’bout it, gentlemen.”"}, {"id": "043-032-0031", "tag": "p", "text": "The doctor and several said “Shucks!” and I see nobody didn’t altogether believe him. One man asked me if I see the niggers steal it. I said no, but I see them sneaking out of the room and hustling away, and I never thought nothing, only I reckoned they was afraid they had waked up my master and was trying to get away before he made trouble with them. That was all they asked me. Then the doctor whirls on me and says:", "sha256": "ac42eea985ce69a674a3f6ca7aa73c717b8622787e7cf865bc4b0f9a271c4897", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[31]", "source_html": "The doctor and several said “Shucks!” and I see nobody didn’t altogether believe him. One man asked me if I see the niggers steal it. I said no, but I see them sneaking out of the room and hustling away, and I never thought nothing, only I reckoned they was afraid they had waked up my master and was trying to get away before he made trouble with them. That was all they asked me. Then the doctor whirls on me and says:"}, {"id": "043-032-0032", "tag": "p", "text": "“Are you English, too?”", "sha256": "82caa64289a24138f5b911ff29f4f62be085249fa107cb66c6f083888a6ff28f", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[32]", "source_html": "“Are you English, too?”"}, {"id": "043-032-0033", "tag": "p", "text": "I says yes; and him and some others laughed, and said, “Stuff!”", "sha256": "91c6d376ded92ea2f1192df62e85a52c98c8f952d8ad7afd5cc101fc96ebe1a0", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[33]", "source_html": "I says yes; and him and some others laughed, and said, “Stuff!”"}, {"id": "043-032-0034", "tag": "p", "text": "Well, then they sailed in on the general investigation, and there we had it, up and down, hour in, hour out, and nobody never said a word about supper, nor ever seemed to think about it—and so they kept it up, and kept it up; and it was the worst mixed-up thing you ever see. They made the king tell his yarn, and they made the old gentleman tell his’n; and anybody but a lot of prejudiced chuckleheads would a seen that the old gentleman was spinning truth and t’other one lies. And by-and-by they had me up to tell what I knowed. The king he give me a left-handed look out of the corner of his eye, and so I knowed enough to talk on the right side. I begun to tell about Sheffield, and how we lived there, and all about the English Wilkses, and so on; but I didn’t get pretty fur till the doctor begun to laugh; and Levi Bell, the lawyer, says:", "sha256": "1464427caf527c7eaed45f007b9c2aa8273f3133fbfe370f4496f6e20df147a1", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[34]", "source_html": "Well, then they sailed in on the general investigation, and there we had it, up and down, hour in, hour out, and nobody never said a word about supper, nor ever seemed to think about it—and so they kept it up, and kept it up; and it was the worst mixed-up thing you ever see. They made the king tell his yarn, and they made the old gentleman tell his’n; and anybody but a lot of prejudiced chuckleheads would a seen that the old gentleman was spinning truth and t’other one lies. And by-and-by they had me up to tell what I knowed. The king he give me a left-handed look out of the corner of his eye, and so I knowed enough to talk on the right side. I begun to tell about Sheffield, and how we lived there, and all about the English Wilkses, and so on; but I didn’t get pretty fur till the doctor begun to laugh; and Levi Bell, the lawyer, says:"}, {"id": "043-032-0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Set down, my boy; I wouldn’t strain myself if I was you. I reckon you ain’t used to lying, it don’t seem to come handy; what you want is practice. You do it pretty awkward.”", "sha256": "3a3260076c70c56d6d20ead860e2b91779bf03bc5960b00329de5cad169cfe6e", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[35]", "source_html": "“Set down, my boy; I wouldn’t strain myself if I was you. I reckon you ain’t used to lying, it don’t seem to come handy; what you want is practice. You do it pretty awkward.”"}, {"id": "043-032-0036", "tag": "p", "text": "I didn’t care nothing for the compliment, but I was glad to be let off, anyway.", "sha256": "e724b065a05795811fb360e93bce404f8c4f6b0b2be44c79ecd015cee6865a13", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[36]", "source_html": "I didn’t care nothing for the compliment, but I was glad to be let off, anyway."}, {"id": "043-032-0037", "tag": "p", "text": "The doctor he started to say something, and turns and says:", "sha256": "f26b874d096f637f21bc4b823e56544f25ae6c1747d8026893620d0fd2da3c95", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[37]", "source_html": "The doctor he started to say something, and turns and says:"}, {"id": "043-032-0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“If you’d been in town at first, Levi Bell—” The king broke in and reached out his hand, and says:", "sha256": "bf50bbdc840d175ba8c55d915b3919b0d0d740176f9d7dc00e945c48d32c8da4", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[38]", "source_html": "“If you’d been in town at first, Levi Bell—” The king broke in and reached out his hand, and says:"}, {"id": "043-032-0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, is this my poor dead brother’s old friend that he’s wrote so often about?”", "sha256": "de749ed9f50bab459f4c07629e7a1ff48c866ad0789175487c0fe63ac0850178", "source_location": "div.chapter[34]/*[39]", "source_html": "“Why, is this my poor dead brother’s old friend that he’s wrote so often about?”"}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-032-0020", "target": "— Думаю, узнал бы, только не уверен. А, вон он, глядите. Я его без труда узнаю.", "source_sha256": "7910da1aff4008c7353d495b3bc27e7adbe61a0d91a45afb242ece622596abaa", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0020", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "04c883edb837d4772774735e393798c250289781d88f08be0f6680b9275cccdd"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0021", "target": "Он показал прямо на меня. Доктор говорит:", "source_sha256": "8b87b0e44f537f0e7f14d5129f267269175a111d724b1cf26c8c5bafc1c19bab", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0021", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4c4878019f11e33419cc065a72c88257083120f384df1e070626ca2d79f16c6e"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0022", "target": "— Соседи, я не знаю, мошенники эти новые двое или нет; но если эти не мошенники, то я просто дурак, и всё тут. По-моему, наш долг — не выпускать их отсюда, пока мы не разберёмся в этом деле. Идёмте, Хайнс; идёмте, все остальные. Отведём этих молодцов в трактир, сведём их лицом к лицу с той, другой парой, и, думаю, мы кое-что выясним, прежде чем всё кончится.", "source_sha256": "38db458ea2dba23a525c09a95ed6ab0f33cf74fbecfc75192a1ff0f4f35ddc38", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0022", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "75672356c056981525941a9a3d870718311ed8a884d06e923c856d54ee5af629"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0023", "target": "Толпе это было по вкусу, хотя, может, не друзьям короля; и мы все двинулись. Было около заката. Доктор вёл меня за руку, был вполне любезен, но руку мою ни разу не отпустил.", "source_sha256": "32ed08cff878b0fd841d9fdb040798a26f2cd15528f85f7bf142ba51a40f37d1", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0023", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8b317f863108d8dc758d759471ca7d5347d2c08d959d02588e879fd768a83422"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0024", "target": "Доктор ведёт Гека", "source_sha256": "4ea26046ea2992911cf9ee26925be66828b2c9ea2fad9da52da2abeae831e9ba", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0024", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "eb80e714c43f5b7f8a812a30b6cd926ee0d1cee95a4023f4cd15897eea08f027"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0025", "target": "Мы все набились в большую комнату в гостинице, зажгли свечи и привели новую пару. Сперва доктор говорит:", "source_sha256": "fb148224f405d1604889c65d9778933a763f8b37b082b9599e7c597af9746d03", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0025", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9f66fb4b7da5f3c83d826347917cf259511a1ff8419b9967e3f2ed317318883b"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0026", "target": "— Я не хочу быть слишком суров с этими двумя людьми, но я думаю, что они мошенники, и у них могут быть сообщники, о которых мы ничего не знаем. Если так, разве сообщники не удерут с тем мешком золота, что оставил Питер Уилкс? Это очень даже возможно. Если эти люди не мошенники, они не станут возражать против того, чтобы послать за этими деньгами и оставить их у нас, пока они не докажут свою правоту. Разве не так?", "source_sha256": "34e8814e4ba64c0b58e3fbcc01f6beecbc1f402646c4b5c2c45bf81b6cad43f2", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0026", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a3beab347ef10a9d49a9b38a9bf65c5f67e9b4f9dbab61ce769f84b246697b81"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0027", "target": "Все с этим согласились. И я рассудил, что нашу шайку с самого начала зажали в довольно тесный угол. Но король только скорбно посмотрел и говорит:", "source_sha256": "8cf7b828298cac4be604485cb0b753eac84cb834163bf59b30cf4ee17da25a47", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0027", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ba44a0eb7c0576f1ecd913e304b6086abd610ad158e178e946bd07a3ebdcba60"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0028", "target": "— Господа, я бы хотел, чтобы деньги были там, ибо у меня нет ни малейшего желания чинить препятствия честному, открытому, окончательному разбирательству этого несчастного дела; но, увы, денег там нет; можете послать и убедиться, если угодно.", "source_sha256": "a25a063dd9c36a36922f455b91ad730cd726b9c176b68b23fe7c82a9375fb868", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0028", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c9aa692d66afe74a2106f8484eaaa1bbe13dd489ecef734a9ed86803f21d8c1b"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0029", "target": "— А где же они тогда?", "source_sha256": "975d2d4c04d223ef27b998bc28e9bb9bc58ea8da340e4efcc848fedff11103d2", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0029", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "76f1f1283fc6d0f30533163ae0c4fdd6cddfad38e9e940b4ac1f7077a0f6a8c9"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0030", "target": "— Ну, когда племянница отдала мне их на сохранение, я взял и спрятал их в соломенный тюфяк на своей кровати: класть в банк на те несколько дней, что мы здесь пробудем, не хотелось, а кровать я почитал местом надёжным, ведь мы к неграм не привычны и считали их честными, как слуг в Англии. Негры украли деньги на следующее же утро, как я спустился вниз; а когда я их продавал, я ещё не хватился денег, так что они удрали с ними подчистую. Мой слуга вот тут может рассказать вам об этом, господа.", "source_sha256": "910bb362c53cf113ddc3ab99b105e8173789d1f315ec4d5c7b14ea5ddf65d8a1", "target_id": "ru-043-032-0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d757f3cf8936e079a12434a59c477cb1b007128d29085e02173150bd2ba82204"}, {"source_id": "043-032-0031", "target": "Доктор и ещё несколько человек сказали: «Вздор!» — и я видел, что никто не поверил ему до конца. Один человек спросил меня, видел ли я, как негры это украли.
